title: Queen and king vs king
hint: Use the queen to shrink the box the king can move in, then bring your own king up. Watch out for stalemate.

title: Queen vs king, from the far corner
hint: Trap the king on the edge with the queen a knight's move away, then walk your king over.

title: Two rooks: the ladder mate
hint: The rooks take turns checking, each cutting off one more rank. Your king is not needed.

title: Rook and king vs king
hint: Cut the king off with the rook, face it with your king, and check when the kings stand opposite each other.

title: Two bishops vs king
hint: Keep the bishops side by side to build a wall, and drive the king into a corner.

title: Bishop and knight vs king
hint: Mate is only possible in a corner of the bishop's colour. Drive the king to the edge, then along it with the knight's W manoeuvre.

title: King on the sixth in front of the pawn
hint: Step aside with the king to take control of the queening square, then push the pawn.

title: King two squares ahead of the pawn
hint: Lead with the king, not the pawn. Take the opposition and use spare pawn moves only when you need to pass the move.

title: Holding the draw against a pawn
hint: Stay in front of the pawn. When you must retreat, go straight back so you can take the opposition.

title: Rook pawn: the corner draws
hint: Head for the corner in front of the pawn. Once there you cannot be driven out.

title: Réti's study: catch the uncatchable pawn
hint: Move the king diagonally: every step both chases the h-pawn and comes closer to supporting your own.

title: Wrong-coloured bishop
hint: The bishop cannot control the queening square, so just stay in or next to the corner.

title: Lucena position: building a bridge
hint: Check the king away, lift your rook to the fourth rank, then walk your king out and block the checks with the rook.

title: Philidor position: the third-rank defence
hint: Keep your rook on your third rank until the pawn advances to it, then drop the rook to the far end and check from behind.

title: Queen vs pawn on the seventh
hint: Check until the king is forced to step in front of its pawn; each time it does, bring your own king one square closer.
